title: Security That Goes Beyond Scanning
subtitle: StrikeDefend is a cybersecurity company focused on helping businesses identify, understand, and reduce real security risks.
paragraphs: We provide practical security assessments across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud environments, and infrastructure. Our approach combines automated security tools with manual analysis to identify vulnerabilities that scanners alone may miss.
Our goal is simple: find what matters, explain the real impact, and help your team fix it.
whyIntro: Cybersecurity reports are often filled with technical findings, false positives, and complicated terminology. We believe security testing should provide clear answers:

whyItems.title: What is vulnerable?
whyItems.text: Identify the specific weakness in your application, API, or environment.

whyItems.title: Can it actually be exploited?
whyItems.text: Validate whether the issue is theoretical or a real attack path.

whyItems.title: What could an attacker achieve?
whyItems.text: Explain the practical impact on data, accounts, and business operations.

whyItems.title: How serious is the risk?
whyItems.text: Prioritize findings by exploitability and business harm — not scanner noise.

whyItems.title: What should be fixed first?
whyItems.text: Give your team a clear order of remediation that reduces risk fastest.

whyClosing: StrikeDefend focuses on validated vulnerabilities and real-world business impact rather than simply delivering scanner results.
missionBody: Our mission is to make professional cybersecurity testing practical, understandable, and actionable for businesses of every size. We help organizations discover weaknesses before attackers do and provide the information their technical teams need to strengthen security with confidence.

differentItems.title: Human Expertise + Security Automation
differentItems.text: Automated tools help identify potential weaknesses. Our approach goes further by manually validating important findings and analyzing how they could affect your application or business.

differentItems.title: Real-World Attack Thinking
differentItems.text: We don't only ask whether something is technically vulnerable. We ask: “What could an attacker actually achieve with this vulnerability?” — uncovering risks in authorization, APIs, accounts, workflows, and logic.

differentItems.title: Actionable Findings
differentItems.text: Clear vulnerability descriptions, severity and business impact, reproduction steps, technical evidence, and practical remediation guidance — so developers can fix issues without more confusion.

differentItems.title: Fix. Retest. Verify.
differentItems.text: Finding vulnerabilities is only part of the process. After remediation, we can retest reported issues to verify that the security weaknesses have been properly resolved.

protectTitle: Coverage across your real attack surface

protectItems.title: Web Applications
protectItems.text: Authentication, authorization, sessions, inputs, business logic, and application security.

protectItems.title: Mobile Applications
protectItems.text: Android and iOS application security, local storage, APIs, authentication, and platform risks.

protectItems.title: APIs
protectItems.text: Authentication, authorization, token security, object access, data exposure, and business logic.

protectItems.title: Cloud Environments
protectItems.text: Cloud configuration, identity and access management, storage, public exposure, and security posture.

protectItems.title: Infrastructure
protectItems.text: Network exposure, services, configurations, and potential attack paths.

protectItems.title: Business Workflows
protectItems.text: Payments, approvals, account actions, transactions, and other business-critical processes.

approachTitle: A structured path from scope to retest
approachIntro: We follow a structured security assessment process designed to provide meaningful and reproducible results.

approachSteps.title: Understand
approachSteps.text: Application, environment, user roles, workflows, and authorized scope.

approachSteps.title: Discover
approachSteps.text: Map apps, APIs, services, parameters, auth flows, and attack surfaces.

approachSteps.title: Test
approachSteps.text: Security testing across relevant technical and business-risk areas.

approachSteps.title: Validate
approachSteps.text: Manually review findings to confirm real security risk.

approachSteps.title: Prioritize
approachSteps.text: Rank by exploitability, technical impact, and business impact.

approachSteps.title: Remediate
approachSteps.text: Practical recommendations for your development or infrastructure team.

approachSteps.title: Retest
approachSteps.text: Confirm remediation succeeded for reported vulnerabilities.

principlesTitle: How we work with every engagement

principles.title: Integrity
principles.text: We report what we can demonstrate and clearly distinguish confirmed vulnerabilities from potential concerns.

principles.title: Clarity
principles.text: Security findings should be understandable by both technical teams and business stakeholders.

principles.title: Responsibility
principles.text: Security testing is performed only against systems and environments that are explicitly authorized for assessment.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.text: Application information, credentials, findings, and technical evidence are treated as sensitive information.

principles.title: Continuous Improvement
principles.text: Cybersecurity is not a one-time activity. Applications, infrastructure, technologies, and threats continue to change.

beyondTesterText: Should this user have been allowed to perform this action?
beyondIntro: That difference can reveal vulnerabilities such as:
beyondClose: Technology helps us test faster. Human analysis helps us understand what actually matters.
trustIntro: When you work with a cybersecurity company, you are trusting them with sensitive information about your systems. We take that responsibility seriously.

trustItems.title: Controlled Testing
trustItems.text: Testing is performed within an agreed and authorized scope.

trustItems.title: Confidential Handling
trustItems.text: Security information and vulnerability evidence are handled carefully.

trustItems.title: Evidence-Based Reporting
trustItems.text: Important findings are supported by reproducible technical evidence.

trustItems.title: Practical Communication
trustItems.text: We explain security risks clearly so your team can make informed decisions.

expectItems.title: Transparent Communication

expectItems.title: Validated Findings

closingTitle: Security Is Not Just About Finding Vulnerabilities
closingBody: It is about understanding which vulnerabilities matter most and what they mean for your business. At StrikeDefend, we combine security tools, technical expertise, manual validation, and business context to help organizations make better security decisions.
ctaTitle: Know Your Risk Before Attackers Do
ctaSubtitle: Whether you're preparing for a new release, reviewing an existing application, moving services to the cloud, or strengthening your overall security posture, StrikeDefend can help you understand where you're exposed.
